t: The oath sworn about who comes out
a: وَلَكِنْ وَعِزَّتِي وَكِبْرِيَائِي وَعَظَمَتِي وَجِبْرِيَائِي لأُخْرِجَنَّ مَنْ قَالَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ
p: Wa lākin wa ʿizzatī wa kibriyāʾī wa ʿaẓamatī wa jibriyāʾī la-ukhrijanna man qāla lā ilāha illā-Llāh
m: But by My might and My pride and My greatness and My majesty, I will most certainly bring out whoever said there is no god but Allah.
